这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 Krea 2 文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过此处使用的 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。

Krea 2 (K2) 基础模型由 Krea AI 开发，是专门为创意专业人士设计的“美学优先”引擎的潜在扩散架构。虽然 Black Forest Labs 的 Flux.2 [klein] 针对超快速、紧凑的足迹（参数范围从 4B 到 9B 参数）和本地图像编辑进行了优化，但众所周知，它在正确的人体解剖学方面遇到了困难。 Krea 2 通过优先考虑视觉连贯性并利用高度专业化的数据集克服了这一问题，该数据集的标题具有巨大的审美意图。此外，Krea 2 本质上在角色一致性方面表现出色，因为它本身支持混合多达 10 个风格和构图参考图像，映射各代之间的潜在注意力，以防止在推动轻量级 Klein 时发生解剖学破坏和“AI 外观” 模型。

您可以从 CivitAI 的 HuggingFace 和 LORA 下载此工作流程中使用的必要模型文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream O1、Ernie Image、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、NoobAI、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B、Flux.1 Dev 的其他工作流程和 Kandinsky Image 5 Lite（T2I 和 I2I）型号。请随意在您喜欢的其他内容（LORA、实用程序、数据集等）上添加一些黄色 Buzz 我。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Krea 2 模型文件，然后

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的 Kite 按钮。

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your Krea 2 Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used here you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately.

Developed by Krea AI, the Krea 2 (K2) foundation models are latent diffusion architectures designed specifically as "aesthetic-first" engines for creative professionals. While Black Forest Labs' Flux.2 [klein] is optimized for ultra-fast, compact footprints (ranging from 4B to 9B parameters) and local image editing, it notoriously struggles with correct human anatomy. Krea 2 overcomes this by prioritizing visual coherence and utilizing a highly specialized dataset that is captioned with immense aesthetic intention. Furthermore, Krea 2 inherently excels at character consistency because it natively supports blending up to 10 style and composition reference images, mapping latent attention across generations to prevent the anatomical breaking and "AI look" that occurs when pushing the lightweight Klein models.

You can download your necessary model files used in this workflow from HuggingFace and LORA from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream O1, Ernie Image, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, NoobAI, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B, Flux.1 Dev and Kandinsky Image 5 Lite (T2I & I2I) models. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on other stuffs (LORAs, utilities, Datasets etc.) you like from me.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Krea 2 model files first and

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button.

Required Files

===============

### Download Link for Krea 2 models -

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

I used the following models for this workflow on my computer with 8 GB VRAM and they worked very well -

https://huggingface.co/vantagewithai/Krea-2-Raw-GGUF/resolve/main/krea2_raw-Q2_K.gguf

https://huggingface.co/vantagewithai/Krea-2-Turbo-GGUF/resolve/main/krea2_turbo-Q2_K.gguf

**All the example generations of this workflow have used the Turbo model but they can be reproduced with Raw on slower speed with not much quality improvements, since most Krea2 LORAs have been trained for Turbo I used the Turbo model as default for this workflow.

Alternatively if you have higher VRAM (16 GB or above) you can try models from here -

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/tree/main
